title: Retired-check disposition audit notes should distinguish attempted exclusion from completed admission
outcome: A refused post-note evaluation attempt leaves an audit entry that accurately says it was attempted or pending, or is rejected by a dry admission preflight before writing; retries do not imply that an evaluator actually started.
acceptance: A behavioral case in which excluding admission or current-root sighting refuses after disposition selection does not leave a misleading completed-exclusion claim.
Successful disposition admission keeps the original check, requester attribution, note evidence and no-credit semantics, and all existing refusal controls remain meaningful.
